# THIRD INDEX

> Independent technology studio designing and building custom web applications, storefronts, and product interfaces.

THIRD INDEX is based in Las Vegas, led by Michael Ciccarelli, and works with brands, agencies, founders, and product teams worldwide. The practice designs and builds web applications, storefronts, product interfaces, and websites.

It is a principal-led technology studio: product design, custom development, frontend consulting and audits, and production implementation. Not a branding shop or marketing agency.

Core capabilities include product interfaces, design system implementation, custom websites, web applications, frontend architecture, motion, WebGL, editorial platforms, and headless commerce.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://thirdindex.co/): Single landing page covering the practice, selected work, capabilities, technology stack, clients, ways to work together, and contact entry points.
- [Selected work](https://thirdindex.co/#work): Representative product, platform, website, commerce, and editorial projects.
- [Studio and capabilities](https://thirdindex.co/#studio): Who leads the practice, focus areas, clients, and technology stack.

## Ways to work together

There are two engagement shapes: a scoped project priced by the week, or embedded work priced by the month.

- [Project](https://thirdindex.co/project): From $5k/week, usually one to three weeks, with scope and price fixed before work starts. Common projects: a frontend audit (one week — a senior review of architecture, performance, accessibility, and design system health, delivered as a written, ranked plan), a prototype (one to two weeks — a clickable, deployed prototype of the core flows), a frontend build (one to three weeks — finished designs turned into production code), or a design system (two weeks — existing designs turned into a coded, documented component library).
- [Embedded (fractional engineering)](https://thirdindex.co/fractional): From $10k/month for two days a week, embedded with a product team, three-month minimum. Three days a week from $14k/month.

## Capabilities

- Product interface development and application UI
- Design systems, tokens, components, and documentation (implementation, not original visual design)
- Custom websites, campaigns, and web applications
- Website rebuilds, including information architecture, navigation, and technical SEO
- CMS systemization: content modeling, editing experience, and page-building components
- Creative frontend development, motion, canvas, and WebGL
- Frontend architecture, performance, accessibility, and migrations
- Headless commerce and editorial platforms

## Technology

Primary tools include TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Motion, Three.js, WebGL, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Shopify, Sanity, Stripe, and Figma. The stack is selected to fit each engagement.

## Representative clients and work

Representative names include Modern Treasury, VICE, Amazon, Condé Nast, Pentagram, Legend, One/Of, Elara, Revolve Law, Kelvon Agee, The Well, and El Dorado.

## Fit

THIRD INDEX is first and foremost custom web development and senior frontend engineering — websites, web applications, product interfaces, and digital platforms — supported by full-stack capability, product judgment, motion, and systems thinking. Design ability is enough to close gaps without supervision; it is not a standalone design offering.

A strong fit for teams shipping web products and brand surfaces where engineering craft, accessibility, maintainability, and senior technical judgment matter — and for design studios and designers who need a technical partner to execute and systematize their work. Engagements may be project-based or fractional.

The studio is not focused on pure backend infrastructure, visual design without implementation, branding or marketing production, or native iOS and Android development.
